text_block_list.text: —The morning of the 'Arima Kinen'.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Big sis! I'm rooting for you today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
! Heh... keep your eyes on me! Watch my 
one-on-one duel!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow right past Brian and Laurel with 
these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Teio-chan. How do you make 
miracles happen?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya has to run in a way that pierces 
right through their hearts, too! Hey... 
teach me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Grandma, guess what! I found another 
marvelous thing!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna run with everyone, too! 
Lots and loooots... ☆★

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard you put up a good time in that 
mock race the other day. They said your 
finishing stretch showed plenty of promise 
for future growth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I heard Sis's rehab is going well too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. My return date isn't set yet, but 
I'll definitely be back on the field with 
all of you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry it took me so long to say it. I 
wanted to be a dependable older sister to 
you, with no weaknesses at all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, I should just say it honestly right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep my eyes on your backs, and this 
time, I'll chase you down from behind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So Brian, you go on ahead of me. Catch up 
to that back you want to chase.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: It's about to begin—the "Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The year-end showdown. A place where 
countless hopes and feelings converge.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I think today is going to be a truly 
heated race.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, but you've prepared over and over 
for this.

Yeah, but you've prepared for this over 
and over.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To grasp that distant light, I need 
legs that can keep running the distance to 
my dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I've nurtured it together with you to come 
this far.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I believe today's "ideal to strive for" 
will return even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Even so, I will surpass even that longing.
choice_data_list: Let's get fired up and do this!
Get fired up and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes!!
And now, the Arima Kinen begins—
